value.rationale: The natural biharmonic diffusion semigroup on a major family of highly symmetric graphs contracts in ℓ² yet overshoots in ℓ∞. The theorem calculates worst-case bounded-input amplification at every time, its unique maximum, and a universal degree-only instability onset distinguished from the geometry-dependent recovery threshold. This is a structural uniform family result, not a routine single-graph numerical table.
